jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Associate Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Join a multibillion\-dollar global company that brings together amazing technology, people, and operational scale to become a powerhouse in the memory industry. Headquartered in Rancho Cordova, California, Solidigm combines elements of an established, successful technology company with the spirit, agility, and entrepreneurial mindset of a start\-up. In addition to the U.S. headquarters and other facilities in the U.S., the company has international presence in Asia, Europe, and the Americas. Solidigm will continue to lead the world in innovating new Memory technologies with aspirations to be the \#1 NAND memory company in the world. At Solidigm, we view problems as opportunities to define innovative solutions that hold the power to change the world and unleash the potential technological needs that the future holds. At Solidigm, we are One Team that fosters a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture that embraces individual uniqueness and empowers us to bring our best selves to deliver excellence in support of Solidigm's vision and mission to be the go\-to partner for optimized data storage solutions. You can be part of the takeoff of an innovative business that develops cutting\-edge products, delivers strong business value for customers, provides an engaging workplace for its employees, and serves a greater impact on the world. This is a golden opportunity for the right applicant to join us and help design, build, and lead Solidigm. We want a diverse team of dedicated professionals who will not just be Solidigm team members but contribute to how we shape the future of the organization. We are seeking applicants who will grow and thrive in our culture; be customer inspired, trusting, innovative, team\-oriented, inclusive, results driven, collaborative, passionate, and flexible.

 **Job Description**  

This is a commissioned role. The Associate Account Manager is an entry\-level sales and account management role within Solidigm’s Global Sales Group (GSG). Solidigm is a leader in advanced NAND technology and SSD solutions serving Hyperscaler, OEM, Neocloud and NAS customers. This role supports account teams in developing customer relationships, coordinating internal execution, tracking account priorities, and contributing to business outcomes across assigned accounts. The ideal candidate is customer\-focused, detail\-oriented, and motivated to develop commercial, operational, and technical knowledge in the semiconductor and storage industry. Successful candidates will have the opportunity to work directly with some of the world's largest AI infrastructure, cloud, OEM, and storage customers while developing the commercial and technical skills required for future Account Manager roles.

**Key** **Responsibilities**

* Support account managers and Field Applications Engineers (FAEs) in understanding customer needs, tracking account priorities, and ensuring timely follow\-through on customer requests.
* Develop foundational knowledge of customer requirements, Solidigm products, sales processes, and market dynamics to support opportunity identification and account growth.
* Assist in preparing customer\-facing materials, meeting follow\-ups, business reviews, forecasts, and internal updates for strategic and tactical account discussions.
* Coordinate with Sales, Engineering, Strategic Planning, Global Operations, and other cross\-functional stakeholders to support customer execution and business commitments.

**Operational Responsibilities**

* Create, maintain, and update account plans, opportunity trackers, customer action logs, and account documentation.
* Maintain accurate opportunity information, meeting notes, customer contacts, and sales activity records in CRM systems.
* Support pipeline development, forecast preparation, design win tracking, and revenue reporting in partnership with account leadership.
* Partner with internal teams to help resolve customer issues, coordinate deliverables, and ensure effective operational, logistical, and technical support for assigned accounts.

**Required Skills and Competencies**

* Ability to travel up to 50%
* Strong interest in sales, customer engagement, semiconductor technology, cloud infrastructure, data centers, or enterprise storage solutions.
* Ability to learn technical concepts quickly and communicate product, supply, and business information clearly to internal and customer audiences.
* Customer\-focused mindset with strong follow\-through, responsiveness, and commitment to supporting account teams in a fast\-paced environment.
* Foundational understanding of business processes such as forecasting, pricing, contracts, supply coordination, customer meetings, or quarterly business reviews.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize information clearly and professionally.
* Active listening skills, sound judgment, and the ability to engage professionally with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work across functions to support issue resolution and customer expectations.
* Analytical mindset, attention to detail, and ability to organize account information, customer inputs, and business updates into actionable insights.
* Curiosity and willingness to develop knowledge of storage technologies, SSD products, customer workloads, and market trends.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities under guidance from account leadership.
* Ability to build productive working relationships with peers, managers, cross\-functional teams, and customer contacts.
* Growth mindset, professionalism, and commitment to continuous learning, team execution, and customer success.
* Ability to connect customer requirements, internal execution, and business objectives to support account planning and opportunity development.

  

**Qualifications** **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Aware Health is a virtual\-first musculoskeletal (MSK) care and lifestyle medicine company helping self\-funded employers reduce healthcare costs and improve outcomes for their members.

The Customer Success Manager will own a portfolio of accounts end\-to\-end, driving implementation, engagement, ROI, retention, and expansion. You'll serve as the primary relationship holder for your accounts, managing the employer, the broker, and the member experience simultaneously.

This is not an entry\-level role. We're looking for someone who comes in ready to own their book, communicate with confidence in the language of employee benefits and self\-funded health plans, and hit the ground running with minimal ramp time. If you've worked in health tech, employee benefits, a TPA, or a benefits consulting firm and you're looking to make the leap to a high\-growth startup, we want to talk with you.

This is a hybrid role based in our San Francisco Financial District office, with required in\-office days Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Remote work is not available for this position

**What You'll Be Measured On**

* **Member Engagement:** Drive each account to at least 20% engagement, with an average of 25%\+ across your book. You'll get there through targeted digital campaigns, HR coordination, onsite visits, and creative outreach strategies.
* **Customer ROI:** Aware Health puts its fees at risk. You'll own the ROI model for each account and be responsible for delivering on it.
* **Net Revenue Retention (NRR):** Your goal is 100% NRR, retaining existing revenue and identifying expansion opportunities within your book.

**What You'll Own**

**Account Management \& Retention**

* Build deep, trusted relationships with employers and brokers; serve as their go\-to on all things Aware Health
* Maintain current account plans for every customer, clearly documenting health, risks, open commitments, and renewal timelines
* Lead renewals independently, with support from leadership on complex situations
* Partner with the analytics team to analyze claims data, utilization, engagement, and cost containment metrics, and translate those into clear, compelling QBR narratives
* Identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities and advance those conversations in partnership with the sales team

**Member Engagement \& Marketing**

* Design and execute integrated marketing campaigns to drive member activation and ongoing engagement
* Coordinate with HR contacts to create awareness and incentive programs that move the needle
* Collaborate with clinical to manage scheduling waves and balance provider bandwidth

**Implementation**

* Act as project manager for new account launches, bringing together data, billing, marketing, and onboarding
* Set customers up for success from day one and capture satisfaction feedback before the first QBR

**Voice of the Customer**

* Capture and surface member and employer feedback to inform product and clinical roadmaps
* Contribute to CS process improvements across onboarding, QBRs, and marketing workflows

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 4\+ years in a Customer Success or Account Management role
* Background in one or more of the following: health tech, employee benefits, self\-funded health plans, MSK/physical therapy, digital health, TPA, or benefits consulting
* Familiarity with how self\-funded employer health plans work, including broker relationships, plan design, and cost containment strategies
* Demonstrated ability to read and communicate using claims data, utilization metrics, or healthcare cost analysis
* Proven track record of retention and growth across a book of business
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Comfort operating in a fast\-moving, startup environment where the playbook is still being written
* Self\-starter who drives their own learning and doesn't wait to be told what to do

**Strongly Preferred**

* Experience working directly with employee benefits brokers or consultants
* Familiarity with B2B2E (business\-to\-business\-to\-employee) models
* HubSpot experience
* Background in MSK health, physical therapy, or virtual care platforms

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Salary $100k base
* Uncapped variable compensation; 1% ARR for retained revenue and 15% commission for expansion
* Early equity stake
* Medical (PPO, HMO, HDHP), dental and vision
* FSA administration
* Life Insurance
* Short/long term disability
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Commuter benefits
* 401K

Pay: $100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Customer Account Manager - Mid Market
jobs.description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world's most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what's next.  

  

Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next\-generation skills.  

  

People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.

**About the team**



We are seeking a **Customer Account Manager** who is deeply committed to customer success and passionate about guiding them through every stage of their journey, driving meaningful outcomes and lasting partnerships.



The Account Management Team plays a key role in supporting HackerRank's growing customer base by partnering with small and mid\-sized businesses as they adopt and scale their technical hiring processes. The team focuses on delivering consistent value through repeatable account motions, strong customer relationships, and reliable renewal execution. We are a collaborative, driven group that takes pride in helping customers succeed at scale.


**About the role**



We are seeking a Customer Account Manager who is committed to delivering a strong customer experience and supporting customers throughout their lifecycle with HackerRank. In this role, you will manage a portfolio of Mid Market customers, ensuring consistent adoption, smooth renewals, and a positive overall experience. You will collaborate closely with teammates and follow established playbooks to support retention and identify straightforward expansion opportunities, with guidance from senior team members.. This position is Full\-Time and Hybrid in Santa Clara, CA.


**What you'll do**


* Manage a portfolio of Mid Market customers, executing defined adoption and renewal motions to drive retention and customer satisfaction.
* Conduct regular customer check\-ins to ensure customers are realizing value and address questions or issues proactively.
* Support renewal conversations and standard contract processes, escalating complex scenarios as needed.
* Act as a strategic advisor by leading customer and internal teams, removing roadblocks, and accelerating adoption.
* Identify basic expansion or usage opportunities and partner with senior team members when appropriate.
* Maintain accurate customer data, renewal tracking, and activity logging in CRM tools.
* Collaborate with Sales, Product, and Support to ensure a smooth and consistent customer experience.


**Who you are**


* You bring 3\+ years of experience in a customer\-facing role within a SaaS or technology environment, such as account management, customer success, or technical support.
* You are organized, resilient, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* You are customer\-focused and curious, motivated by understanding customer needs and ensuring a positive, reliable experience.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts and solutions into clear, accessible language for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain concepts clearly.


**Even better if you have**


* Familiarity with HR Tech, recruiting tools, or developer\-focused products.
* Comfort engaging with day\-to\-day customer contacts in Engineering teams.
* A collaborative mindset. You work seamlessly across teams, bringing together Support, Product, and Sales to ensure customer needs are met.
* Nice to have: Prior software development experience or an academic background in computer science.


**You will thrive in this role if you**


* Demonstrates high agency, takes ownership, and proactively drives work forward with minimal oversight.
* Are a Captain \- you enjoy owning the customer relationship and championing their success.
* Are skilled at engaging HR/Talent \& Technical decision\-makers, helping them navigate hiring and workforce planning goals.
* Believe in long\-term partnerships and being the trusted advisor for your customers.


Current OTE range: 140,000\-160,000\. The exact salary may vary based on skills, experience, location, market ranges, and other compensation offered. The salary range does not include other benefits such as benefits for which you may be eligible. Salary may be adjusted based on business needs.

jobs.description:
**About Handshake**
===================


Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.


In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

**Why join Handshake now:**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast\-growing business with billions in revenue

  

**About the Role**
==================


Account Management at Handshake owns **Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), Net Revenue Retention (NRR), renewals, and expansion revenue** across our customer base.


As an **Account Manager, SMB / Mid\-Market**, you'll own the commercial relationship and growth strategy for a portfolio of approximately **75–130 customers**, acting as a strategic commercial owner rather than a contract\-execution renewal rep. You’ll be accountable for retaining and growing revenue while helping customers maximize the value of their partnership with Handshake.


You’ll partner closely with Customer Success, Sales, RevOps, Product, Support, Finance, and Legal to develop account strategies, mitigate risk, navigate complex customer needs, and identify opportunities to deepen and expand customer relationships.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing **strategic account management, consultative selling, customer advocacy, and operational rigor**. Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. **POSITION SUMMARY**



The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. jobs.title: Technical Success Account Manager, Google Cloud Consulting
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in a customer\-facing technical role.
* Experience with core cloud computing concepts and enterprise architecture principles (e.g., networking, compute, storage, IT security, database systems, application development, operational frameworks).
* Experience presenting to technical and executive stakeholders (e.g., explaining technical concepts to non\-technical audiences).
* Experience supporting customers in cloud operations domains (e.g., launch/capacity planning, product release management, technical support, escalation management procedures).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* MBA or Master's degree in a Management, Technical, or Engineering field.
* Relevant technical professional certifications.
* Experience leading technical governance activities, such as establishing or actively participating in Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), or developing reference architectures and reusable patterns for an enterprise organization.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Technical Success Account Manager (TSAM), you will serve as a leader aligned with Google Cloud’s most critical customers. You will be responsible for driving sustained platform health, achieving technical excellence, and ensuring stability for key business critical workloads running on GCP. The TSAM serves as the customer’s trusted advisor, translating complex business objectives into governance and modern, resilient architectural strategies. You will advocate adoption of industry best practices and act as the primary point of accountability for resolving issues and proactive risk mitigation, to the satisfaction of executive stakeholders.  

This role requires forging strong relationships, advocating implementation standards, elevating reliability, and establishing across the customer’s footprint through a programmatic approach. Additionally, you will serve as the internal customer advocate, translating their needs into actionable feedback for Product and Engineering teams, ensuring continuous service improvement and feature development.
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $174000 \- $252000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Establish and lead Technical Governance, focusing on platform health metrics and enterprise readiness planning.
* Provide technical guidance and advocate the adoption of Google Cloud architecture and best practices via deep dives and workshops.
* Drive platform stability and excellence through deep architectural health assessments.
* Serve as the technical advisor to address and resolve critical reliability concerns, advising on and guiding the architecture of highly, scalable, and resilient workloads.
* Act as the internal customer advocate, translating technical obstacles to influence GCP product roadmaps. Own workload success, stabilization, and ongoing optimization to ensure sustained business value.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Learning & Development Partner Manager, Life Sciences
jobs.description:
**We are:**


Accenture's Life Sciences Reinventive Enterprise practice leads AI\-driven enterprise transformation at the world's leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations. We deploy the Reinvention Force: a human \+ AI team of Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI \& Data Innovators that makes reinvention real at enterprise scale.  

This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact practice with strong momentum and a clear path to Managing Director for high performers.

 **You are:**


An experienced practitioner with proven delivery expertise in your domain. You are analytically rigorous and structured in your thinking. You communicate complex ideas clearly to senior stakeholders. You are comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and thrive in cross\-functional delivery teams. You have supported business development and are ready to take on more. You bring intellectual curiosity, drive, and a genuine interest in how AI is transforming the Life Sciences industry.

  

The Learning \& Development Partner designs and delivers role\-specific training for redesigned roles within the pod's functional scope. This role builds the training curriculum, coordinates delivery alongside each AI release, and measures learning effectiveness to ensure the organization is ready to operate in new ways.

 **The work:**

* Design and deliver role\-specific training for redesigned roles within the pod's functional scope
* Build the training curriculum and coordinate delivery alongside each new technology and AI agent release
* Translate process and role redesigns into practical, accessible learning content for functional audiences
* Measure training effectiveness and learner adoption — adjust curriculum based on feedback and adoption data
* Collaborate with the Workforce Design Lead and change management team to align training with the overall change plan.
* Travel varies by client needs and could be up to 80%

  

**Here’s what you need:**

  

Candidates must have at least 5 years of combined experience in the following:

  

* Instructional design, curriculum development, or enterprise learning in a consulting or corporate environment
* Designing role\-based training programs for technology or process transformation programs
* Experience with digital training delivery platforms and learning management systems (Cornerstone, Workday Learning, or equivalent)
* Ability to translate technical process and role changes into practical, accessible learning content for non\-technical audiences
* Experience measuring training effectiveness with data\-driven curriculum refinement

 **Bonus points if you have:**

  

* ATD, CPTD, or equivalent instructional design certification
* Experience using AI\-generated content tools to accelerate training curriculum development and personalization
* Background in Life Sciences regulatory or compliance training design
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled learning platforms and adaptive learning technologies
* Experience coordinating training delivery across multiple simultaneous technology releases

  

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. jobs.title: Assistant Security Account Manager
jobs.description:
Assistant Security Account Manager

**Overview**
------------

  

Company Overview:
Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.**Job Description**
-------------------

  

Allied Universal is looking to hire an Assistant Account Manager. The Assistant Account Manager job is responsible for assisting the Account Manager with all supervisory, training and operations functions at the assigned post in accordance with post orders and client instructions, and following all internal procedures. To support and ensure success in this role, we provide a comprehensive, week\-long management onboarding course designed to provide best practices, tools and guidance.
**RESPONSIBILITIES:*** Under the direction of the Account Manager, this position assists with the coordination of all aspects (technical and managerial) of executing the security contract at the assigned location. Assigns work tasks to Security Professionals and directs their work throughout the day
* This position is the first direct supervisory contact for shift supervisors (if applicable to site) or for Security Professionals, regarding performance, operations, and department needs. Responsible for supervising, motivating, coaching and training Also responsible for evaluating the work performance of Security Professionals and making recommendations regarding assignments
* Responsible for making sure that Post Order manual and all other post and training information is being properly maintained and updated, and that the Post is being properly maintained, cleaned and organized
* Assist the Account Manager in conducting interviews and evaluating new employees. Responsible for conducting on\-the\-job training, in coordination with Shift Supervisors, of new employees assigned to post, or when changes to post orders are made. This may include orientation to the post, review of post orders, routine responsibilities, and how to respond to emergency situations or specific client needs;
* Oversees all reports, logs and pass downs generated by and for the Security Department. Distributes communications and other information to Security Professionals at post as directed
* Manages and supervises all sub\-units within the Security Department, such as fire control room, command center, and loading docks as applicable to job site. May generate work orders and attached paperwork for extra security coverage requests
* Responds to minor incidents (internal to Security Professionals and/or external to client location) that occur, ensuring appropriate action is taken, all reports are properly completed, and appropriate parties are notified in a timely manner
* Identifies any personnel problems occurring at posts, such as payroll issues, employee relations complaints or other concerns, and forward any such issues to Account Manager or Field Supervisor as appropriate. May be responsible for writing a report of the situation or assisting with an investigation, as directed by Account Manager, Branch Manager or Corporate HR Director

AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. jobs.title: Patient Advocate
jobs.description:
SUMMARY

We are seeking a compassionate and tenacious Patient Advocate to help our patients navigate the complexities and obstacles of the healthcare system. In this role, you will be the bridge between patients and the financial assistance programs that can make life\-changing medications accessible.

This is a meaningful, mission\-driven role. The most successful Patient Advocates at Atlas are people who are energized by helping others navigate complex systems, take pride in accuracy and follow\-through, and bring steady resilience to a high\-caseload environment.

SCHEDULE

Monday–Friday, weekday daytime hours (target 8:00 AM–5:00 PM with a 1\-hour lunch). Specific hours vary by client and time zone assignment. These are fixed, structured hours — this is not a flex\-schedule or self\-directed hours role.

A DAY IN THE LIFE

No two days are identical, and your assignments — including your client, workflows, and manager — may change as the business evolves. Atlas trains all Advocates on multiple workflows and expects full proficiency across whichever you are assigned. Here is what a typical day looks like:

* Reviewing a queue of patient cases and prioritizing based on urgency, deadlines, and program requirements
* Making and receiving calls with patients, physicians' offices, and pharmaceutical assistance programs
* Navigating multiple electronic systems and portals to enroll patients, submit claims, and order medications
* Documenting every action accurately in patient records — detail and accuracy matter here
* Following up on pending applications, resolving denials, and escalating appeals when needed
* Collaborating with teammates and managers to ensure no patient case falls through the cracks
* Adapting quickly when assigned to a new client, workflow, or team — flexibility is a core requirement of this role

This is a high\-accountability, documentation\-intensive role with active performance monitoring. It rewards people who are organized, persistent, comfortable with change, and take satisfaction in completing tasks thoroughly — every day, under consistent oversight.

DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES

* Enroll patients in philanthropic aid, copay, and patient assistance programs
* Manage post\-enrollment work including submitting claims and ordering medications
* Review patient enrollments for accuracy and completeness
* Escalate and appeal patient assistance denials on behalf of patients
* Coordinate medication deliveries to the designated pharmacy in a timely manner
* Provide exceptional customer service to patients and health system clients
* Give patients the information they need to make informed financial decisions about their healthcare
* Maintain accurate, thorough documentation across all systems
* Identify opportunities to improve Atlas products and services
* Adapt to new client assignments, workflows, and team structures as business needs require
* Maintain consistent performance standards regardless of client or workflow assignment

QUALIFICATIONS \& REQUIREMENTS

Required

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Minimum 1 year of experience in a high\-accountability, customer\-facing role
* Strong listening, verbal, and written communication skills
* Proficient computer skills and ability to navigate multiple systems simultaneously
* Exceptional attention to detail
* Ability to offer empathy and emotional support to patients in difficult situations
* Pass standard background check and drug screen
* Complete medical clearance per health system requirements (including vaccination mandates)

Preferred

* Experience working in healthcare, insurance, or social services
* Familiarity with Electronic Medical Records systems (Epic, Cerner, or similar)
* Experience with patient assistance programs, prior authorizations, or insurance navigation

Remote Work Requirements

This is a fully remote position with structured, monitored working hours. The following are non\-negotiable requirements.

Workspace

* A dedicated, private workspace that is HIPAA\-compliant
* A distraction\-free environment where conversations cannot be overheard
* No childcare or ongoing caregiving responsibilities during scheduled work hours
* Camera\-on for all internal meetings, team calls, and manager check\-ins — video is required, not optional
* Active and present during all scheduled hours; this role uses productivity monitoring tools including ActivTrak, Microsoft Teams presence tracking, and others
* Self\-directed work is not the expectation — you will be expected to meet defined daily performance metrics and respond to manager direction in real time

Internet

* Cable or fiber internet provider only (DSL, satellite, and wireless broadband are not permitted)
* Minimum upload speed: 2 Mbps
* Minimum download speed: 5 Mbps
* Wired Ethernet connection required — working wirelessly is prohibited
* This is a work\-from\-home position that requires reliable, high\-speed internet sufficient to perform the essential functions of the role. Employees are responsible for maintaining a suitable connection.

Schedule, Monitoring \& Performance

* You are expected to be logged in, present, and working during your full scheduled shift
* Atlas uses multiple productivity and presence monitoring tools including ActivTrak and Microsoft Teams — activity is tracked throughout the workday
* Performance metrics are actively measured and reviewed — there are clear daily and weekly expectations you will be held to
* All internal meetings require video on — camera use is mandatory, not discretionary
* Managers conduct regular check\-ins and oversight is ongoing, not periodic

Geographic Eligibility

This position is available only to candidates residing in the following states:

Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, New Hampshire, Nevada, New York, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Oregon, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Rhode I

Job Description: Senior Business Analyst, Research Administration

Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) company serving academic and research institutions with research administration software

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced research administrator to lead implementations of our research administration platform at universities, academic medical centers, and independent research institutions. The platform covers pre\-award, post\-award, research compliance, reporting, and funding discovery.

This is a senior, client\-facing role. You will work with client stakeholders, implementation, product, and engineering teams to gather requirements, configure the platform, and bring it live, and you will help shape the product based on what research offices need.

Key ResponsibilitiesLead implementations

· Own the functional side of client implementations from kickoff to go\-live, often across two or three institutions at a time.

· Run discovery workshops with sponsored programs, compliance, and research development staff, and map current\-state and future\-state workflows.

· Configure the platform yourself: routing and approval chains, institutional forms, compliance committee workflows, notifications, and reports.

· Define data migration requirements for proposals, awards, and protocols, and validate migrated data.

· Write integration requirements for HR, finance, and identity systems such as Workday, Banner, Oracle, and PeopleSoft, and work with engineering to deliver them.

· Plan and run user acceptance testing, train client administrators and super users, and support go\-live.

· Raise risks to scope, timeline, or data quality early, with a recommended fix.

Shape the product

· Turn what you learn from clients into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for product and engineering.

· Identify needs that are common across institutions and bring them to the product team.

· Review new features for pre\-award, post\-award, and compliance accuracy before release, including sponsor and federal rule changes.

· Help define and test AI features in the platform.

Be the client's trusted advisor

· Serve as the main functional contact for assigned clients, from directors of sponsored programs to vice presidents for research.

· Recommend process improvements to clients.

· Present at client meetings, webinars, and our annual users conference.

Build the practice

· Create repeatable implementation assets: configuration templates, discovery guides, test scripts, and training materials.

· Mentor junior analysts and implementation staff on research administration and on how our clients work.

· Help sales scope new deals and answer functional questions in RFPs and product demonstrations.

Required Qualifications

· 5 or more years of research administration experience at a university, academic medical center, or research institute, in a central sponsored programs office or a department.

· Hands\-on experience across the award lifecycle, including proposal preparation and submission, award setup, and post\-award management.

· Working knowledge of at least one compliance area, such as IRB, IACUC, conflict of interest, or export control.

· Experience leading or serving as the institution's functional owner on an electronic research administration (eRA) implementation or major upgrade, whether a commercial system or one built in\-house.

· Solid knowledge of Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200\), NIH and NSF policies, and FDP agreements and templates.

· Proven ability to run a working session with senior administrators and faculty, keep it on track, and leave with decisions.

· Clear, structured writing: process maps, requirements, and documentation other people can act on.

· Comfort learning software configuration in depth and working directly with data in spreadsheets and reporting tools.

· Ability to manage several client projects at once without dropping details.

Preferred Qualifications

· Certified Research Administrator (CRA), Certified Pre\-Award Research Administrator (CPRA), or Certified Financial Research Administrator (CFRA).

· System administrator or super user experience with an eRA platform such as Cayuse, Kuali, InfoEd, Huron, or ours.

· Experience with data migration or with integrations to HR, finance, or identity systems.

· Working knowledge of SQL or a business intelligence tool.

· Experience in research development, limited submissions, or internal funding competitions.

· Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or Claude in research administration work.

· Active involvement in NCURA, SRAI, or NORDP.

· Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar tools.

Work Environment

This role is remote and works closely with implementation, product, engineering, and customer success teams. Expect regular client meetings across US time zones and periodic travel for onsite discovery, go\-live support, and our annual users conference.

Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

Sumitomo Pharma Co., Ltd., is a global pharmaceutical company based in Japan with operations in the U.S. (Sumitomo Pharma America, Inc.), focused on addressing patient needs in oncology, urology, women's health, rare diseases, cell \& gene therapies and CNS. With several marketed products and a diverse pipeline of early\- to late\-stage investigational assets, we aim to accelerate discovery, research, and development to bring novel therapies to patients sooner. For more information on SMPA, visit our website https://www.us.sumitomo\-pharma.com

**Job Overview**
----------------

  

Responsible for assisting the Clinical Project Manager (CPM) with the planning, implementation, execution, and management of multiple clinical studies by supporting the CPM in overseeing day\-to\-day operations and assisting as needed with the management of outside Clinical Research Organizations.

 **Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* Supports the CPM to design, develop, and deliver the clinical study per agreed upon timelines.
* Assists in the planning and communication with cross\-functional teams to ensure proper execution and conduct of the clinical trial; generates quality clinical data.
* Monitors the status of clinical data collection of assigned clinical trials
* Assists with preparation of potential investigator site lists and assists with their evaluation for inclusion in the study
* Prepares and reviews study\-related plans and documents when required
* Reviews study\-related plans generated by CROs and vendors, and ensures the documents are in accordance with GCP regulatory requirements and consistent with the protocol for assigned studies
* Participates in the review and finalization of clinical study\-related documents such as protocols, protocol amendments, clinical study reports (CSRs), regulatory submissions and other publications as required
* Participates in meetings – i.e. Study Team Meetings, Investigator Meetings, Monitors’ workshops and CRO Training
* Prepares and delivers program/study updates as determined by project team
* Coordinates the delivery of clinical trial supplies in collaboration with CRO and other team members
* Supports CPM with review of change orders from CROs, vendors and investigator sites (as applicable).
* Provides input into contracts, work orders and/or change orders
* Assists with review and management of invoice tracking/reconciliation
* Ability to anticipate potential study issues and to prepare contingency plans in consultation with the CPM
* Supports the CPM to ensure assigned studies adhere to all applicable regulations and requirements
* Establish collaborative and productive relationships with parent company, internal/external partners and relevant affiliates
* Identifies issues found in clinical studies, communication and oversight of CROs and vendors, and suggests and supports implementation of solutions and mitigations in consultation with the CPM
* Participates in the preparation, review, updating and training of SOPs
* Maintains knowledge of oncology therapeutic area, current medical practice and pharmaceutical regulations in order to ensure best practice across all activities
* May mentor other junior team members
* Perform other duties as requested

 **Key Core Competencies**

  

* Excellent written/oral communication skills
* Demonstrated skills working within a matrix environment
* Ability to work collaboratively with others within and external to the company, including investigators, CROs, vendors and team members in parent company in Japan

* Strong attention to detail and the ability to establish priorities, schedule and meet deadlines.
* Sound judgment, problem solving, leadership, and collaboration in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions to problems
* Familiarity with the design and conduct of clinical trials and project management in relevant therapeutic areas
* Experience evaluating outcomes of clinical trials and basic knowledge of clinical trial outcome standards
* Strong analytical skills with a data driven approach to planning, executing, and problem solving
* Working knowledge of current global regulatory requirements and guidelines for clinical trials

* Strong organizational and project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and timelines.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate across cross\-functional teams and external partners.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and clinical trial systems.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain high\-quality documentation and study records.
* Ability to identify issues, escalate risks appropriately, and support development of mitigation plans.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently while contributing effectively in a team environment.
* Experience with TMF oversight, trial metrics, and study tracking tools.
* Experience in oncology clinical trials preferred.

With more than 26 years of experience building remote commercial programs, we combine people, process, and technology to help our clients reach healthcare professionals and improve product adoption.


We are seeking a motivated Virtual Account Manager to educate healthcare professionals, support product utilization, and build lasting relationships with healthcare providers, prescribers, and customers across acute and post\-acute care settings. The Account Manager will support a diverse portfolio of healthcare products, including wound care, medical devices, dental products, infant formula, and other healthcare solution**s**, by providing product education, identifying customer needs, and delivering consultative support.


This remote role is ideal for a consultative sales professional who is comfortable engaging healthcare professionals virtually, managing a sales pipeline, identifying opportunities for growth, and delivering a high\-quality customer experience. The successful candidate will build trusted relationships with key stakeholders, understand clinical and customer needs, and effectively communicate the value and appropriate use of products across a variety of healthcare environments.


At CONNEXIO Health, you will join a flexible, virtual work environment with a comprehensive benefits package and the opportunity to support healthcare solutions that matter.


Compensation and employment details will be discussed during the interview process and may vary based on experience, qualifications, location, and client needs.


**About the Role**


The Virtual Account Manager will serve as a remote sales and education resource for healthcare professionals across a variety of healthcare products, including wound care, medical devices, dental products, and infant formula.


The position is a *6\-12\-month temporary project,* and continuation beyond the pilot period will depend on the program's success and ongoing business needs. In this role, you will help prescribers understand product use, identify appropriate patient opportunities, support adoption, and maintain productive customer relationships. You will be responsible for meeting activity and sales goals while documenting interactions accurately and following established client and program expectations


**What You'll Do**


* Execute inbound and outbound sales activities using phone, video, email, text, live chat, and other approved communication channels.
* Build and maintain relationships with prescribers, customers, and key contacts in acute and post\-acute care environments.
* Qualify leads, manage follow\-up activity, overcome objections, and close opportunities within an efficient sales cycle.
* Support prescription activity and product utilization by providing timely, professional education and follow\-up.
* Collaborate with management to execute business plans, meet sales and volume targets, and continuously improve program performance.
* Maintain an active pipeline of prospects and customers, including scheduled follow\-up calls, campaign outreach, and inbound inquiries.
* Meet defined activity expectations, such as education sessions, calls, decision\-maker contacts, opportunities opened, and sales closed.
* Document all customer activity accurately in the CRM, including contact details, notes, opportunities, next steps, and scheduled actions.
* Conduct virtual education sessions through video with healthcare professionals on product use, disease\-state context, patient selection, and best practices for patient adoption.
* Adapt communication and solutions to customer needs while staying aligned with product instructions for use and program requirements.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.


**What We're Looking For**

Artisight transforms hospital operations with its Smart Hospital Platform, helping health systems reduce costs, improve efficiency, and enhance patient care. Guided by deep clinical expertise and powered by NVIDIA GPUs, Artisight's voice\-activated sensors and computer vision technology enable real\-time observation, virtual nursing, and automated documentation directly in the EHR. The platform integrates seamlessly with existing workflows to reduce staff burden, accelerate patient throughput, and improve safety. More than 400 hospitals across 30 health systems trust Artisight to deliver measurable results, including cutting patient falls by over 50%, reducing nurse turnover, and saving millions annually.

We're seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead technology deployment and professional services projects across Artisight's healthcare engagements and professional services business. You'll own projects from initiation through closeout, leading cross\-functional teams to deliver on time, within budget, and within scope. Projects may include healthcare technology deployments, site readiness assessments, network infrastructure surveys, structured cabling, equipment installation, testing and validation, system upgrades, and decommissioning.

**This role is a 40 hour/week, remote contractor, based in the U.S., and requires U.S. work authorization.**

Founded in 2010, Eagle Creek Renewable Energy (ECRE) acquires, enhances, and operates hydroelectric power facilities across the United States. Today, Eagle Creek owns and operates 85 facilities across 18 states, with a nearly 700 MW portfolio that provides reliable, low\-carbon power to more than 260,000 homes.  

  

Eagle Creek is committed to creating long\-term value for its stakeholders and the communities it serves through a focus on safety, integrity, innovation, diversity, and stewardship. Through strategic investments, operational excellence, and continued growth, the company aims to expand its renewable energy platform and play a meaningful role in the transition to a cleaner, more sustainable energy future.

The Project Manager is the single accountable point for schedule, budget, risk, and a deliverable set spanning project management, governance, implementation, testing, training, organizational change management, and closeout. jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**SolvOne is expanding our Project Team!**


SolvOne is seeking an experienced Fuels Project Manager to manage underground storage tank (UST) replacements and related fuel\-system construction projects across multiple locations. This position will oversee projects from initial planning and site coordination through construction, startup, and closeout. The Fuels Project Manager will serve as a central point of coordination between customers, contractors, equipment vendors, regulatory agencies, A\&E firms, and other project stakeholders to help ensure projects are completed safely, compliantly, on schedule, and in accordance with the approved scope of work.

***Responsibilities***

* Manage underground storage tank replacement and related petroleum construction projects from planning through completion and closeout.
* Review project scope, site information, drawings, schedules, contractor proposals, and other project documentation to identify requirements and potential project risks.
* Coordinate project activities with customer representatives, general contractors, petroleum contractors, environmental consultants, equipment vendors, and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate permitting, inspections, testing, and regulatory requirements associated with UST and fuel\-system construction projects.
* Track project schedules, milestones, dependencies, and critical activities to help ensure projects remain on schedule.
* Coordinate site shutdowns, tank removal and installation activities, piping and fueling\-system work, testing, inspections, startup, and return\-to\-service activities as applicable.
* Monitor contractor progress and follow up on open issues, delays, deficiencies, and outstanding deliverables.
* Review field conditions and project changes and coordinate resolution of scope, schedule, or construction issues.
* Compare completed work against approved plans, scopes of work, and customer requirements.
* Develop and maintain punch lists and track outstanding items through completion.
* Maintain accurate project records, schedules, status reports, issue logs, photographs, permits, inspection documentation, and closeout records.
* Provide regular project updates to customers and internal stakeholders, including schedule status, open issues, risks, and required decisions.
* Escalate issues that may affect safety, regulatory compliance, cost, schedule, or successful project completion.
* Manage multiple projects in different phases and geographic locations simultaneously.
* Conduct or participate in site visits, construction meetings, project walks, punch walks, and final inspections as required.
* Coordinate travel efficiently to support assigned projects.
* Follow all customer safety, confidentiality, documentation, and site\-access requirements.

***Qualifications***

* Project management experience within the petroleum, fueling, UST, or retail fuel construction industry required.
* Direct experience managing underground storage tank replacement, tank modification, fuel\-system construction, or major petroleum equipment projects strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of UST systems and petroleum construction, including tanks, piping, dispensers, sumps, spill containment, leak detection, and associated fueling equipment.
* Familiarity with permitting, inspections, environmental requirements, and regulatory processes associated with UST construction and replacement projects.
* Experience coordinating petroleum contractors, general contractors, environmental consultants, equipment vendors, inspectors, and customer stakeholders.
* Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, site plans, scopes of work, specifications, schedules, and project documentation.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects, locations, contractors, and deadlines.
* Strong project planning, organization, documentation, and follow\-through skills.
* Ability to identify project risks, anticipate potential delays, and drive issues toward resolution.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with field personnel, contractors, customers, and leadership.
* Ability to work independently, make sound decisions, and manage priorities without continuous supervision.
* Proficiency with standard business applications and the ability to learn customer\-specific project management and reporting systems.
* Ability to efficiently manage geographically dispersed projects.

***What else?***

* This is a full\-time, salaried position working regular business hours, M\-F
* Must be based in OH or PA
* Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record required

jobs.title: IT Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Darkhorse Tech**


Darkhorse Tech provides comprehensive Dental\-Specific IT services to our clients including ongoing support (Managed Services), startup projects \& expansions (planning, design, buildouts) as well as software \& hardware sales and maintenance.


As a leader in the industry, we have created and continue to foster relationships with all leading\-edge technology companies servicing the Dental community. Our company was created by founder and CEO, Reuben Kamp who left his job at a nationwide Dental IT company to build a relationship\-focused version of a Managed Service Provider (MSP) which creates true partnerships with it's clients.


Constantly building on our 13 years of experience we are now servicing roughly 1400 clients nationwide and continue to see massive growth while focusing on maintaining unparalleled support for our Dental Practice partners. With technicians on the ground throughout the country we offer in\-person as well as remote support.


**About You**


Service first. Providing exemplary service means recognizing it. Have you put off a call to your cell phone company because the idea of waiting on hold, requesting a manager only to fight for a solution seems exhausting? Have you ever been pleasantly surprised by a service organization where your call is addressed efficiently, with care and acknowledgement that you are their top priority because you (as a client) are the lifeblood of their business? There is a huge difference in these approaches, and the latter builds loyalty and trust which is vital to the health of any business.


You are solution\-oriented and accountable. When given an opportunity to address an issue you follow service standards and quickly provide a solution, if you can't you are able to escalate the issue and alert your manager to your need/want for knowledge and growth \- all while communicating progress in a professional and engaging manner with the client.


Part of our team! While service tickets are addressed individually our crew is always ready to support one another, you will both receive and provide help as we are all working toward the same goal. Together we provide a level of service that our clients dream of and that we stand behind.

  

**Project Coordinator Summary**


As the Project Coordinator, you will work under the direction of the Project Manager to assist with a variety of administrative tasks and oversee multiple projects. You will also help to ensure that tasks and tickets are completed on time, and maintain communication with clients, vendors, and technicians regarding scope of work and project timelines.


**Ideal Candidate Profile: Project Coordinator**  

The ideal candidate for the Project Coordinator role is highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing a high volume of moving pieces in a fast\-paced environment. This person does not need to be technical, but they do need to be highly dependable with communication, follow\-up, documentation, and ownership of next steps.  

This role is best suited for someone who can bring structure, consistency, and accountability to a busy project environment. The strongest candidate will be someone who understands that successful project coordination depends heavily on clear client communication, timely follow\-through, and making sure no task, update, or commitment falls through the cracks.  

  

**Preferred Experience**  

The strongest candidate will have prior experience in project coordination, operations coordination, scheduling, client coordination, account coordination, or a similar role where they were responsible for keeping multiple workstreams organized and on track.  

Experience in an MSP, IT, or professional services environment is a plus, but not required. More important than industry\-specific experience is the ability to communicate clearly, manage follow\-up, track open items, prioritize effectively, and stay organized when timelines or expectations shift.  

The ideal candidate should have experience supporting multiple concurrent projects, tasks, or client requests at one time. They should be able to demonstrate that they have successfully managed competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment where client communication, follow\-through, and attention to detail were critical.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

The Project Coordinator will work under the direction of the Project Manager to help coordinate multiple active projects at one time. This role is responsible for tracking project\-related tasks and tickets, coordinating schedules, communicating with clients and vendors, and helping ensure timelines and expectations remain clear.  

  

**Responsibilities include:**


* Communicate clearly and proactively with clients regarding scope, scheduling, timelines, updates, and next steps


* Follow up consistently on open items, pending responses, delayed tasks, and outstanding action items


* Track and follow up on project tasks, tickets, timelines, and commitments


* Ensure client communications are timely, professional, accurate, and client\-friendly


* Coordinate internal scheduling for project\-related work, including onsite and remote work


* Communicate with vendors regarding scheduling, timelines, deliverables, and project\-related needs


* Respond to client questions and requests in a timely and professional manner


* Help manage client expectations and escalate concerns, delays, blockers, or timeline risks appropriately


* Coordinate with internal teams, project resources, vendors, procurement, and installation resources


* Collaborate with Procurement to monitor the status and timing of ordered parts or equipment


* Coordinate travel for Installation Technicians when required


* Assist with creating and updating internal processes, policies, and procedures


* Handle sensitive information with confidentiality and professionalism


* Support training for Project team members and new hires as needed

jobs.description:
Description:  


Position Summary  


The Quality Assurance Auditor is responsible for conducting detailed audits of all billing activities and accounts worked within the billing software system. This includes reviewing claim follow\-up, collections efforts, resolution of denials, and special billing projects or programs. The auditor ensures compliance with internal protocols, payer regulations, and industry standards.  


This role plays a critical part in identifying trends, ensuring accuracy, and improving the overall efficiency and effectiveness of the billing and collections process.  


Essential Duties and Responsibilities  


Audit daily work completed by billing staff, including claim submissions, follow\-up activities, and collection efforts.  
Review account documentation, actions taken, and billing outcomes within the billing system to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance.  
Identify errors, discrepancies, and trends that may impact reimbursement, operational efficiency, or regulatory compliance.  
Provide detailed audit findings, feedback, and recommendations to billing staff and leadership to improve performance and accuracy.  
Monitor, address, and audit special projects (e.g., credit card chargebacks and high priority payer follow up) and programs (e.g., AB75\) to ensure adherence to established billing protocols.  
Collaborate with team leads, supervisors, and managers to develop, implement, and refine policies, procedures, and workflows based on audit results.  
Assist with the training and education of staff on documentation standards, payer requirements, billing procedures, and industry best practices.  
Participate in quality assurance initiatives and prepare reports for leadership summarizing audit results, performance trends, and opportunities for improvement.  
Maintain current knowledge of industry regulations, payer policies, and billing software updates applicable to medical billing and accounts receivable.  
Support internal and external audit requests by gathering documentation, performing reviews, and responding to audit inquiries as needed.  
Perform manual tasks within Cross Workflow, including but not limited to AR Support Requests and AR Follow\-Up Requests, while addressing high\-priority emails from Patient Services related to invoices involving legal representation and time\-sensitive deadlines.  
Conduct audits for compliance, as assigned or requested to ensure adherence to company policies, payer guidelines, and regulatory requirements.  


Other Duties  


Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.  


Requirements:  


Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities  


Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and focus  
Strong organizational skills to ensure deadlines are met  
Strong knowledge of medical billing and accounts receivable processes, including claim lifecycle, denials, and payer rules.  
Proficient in using billing software and electronic health record (EHR) systems.  
High attention to detail and accuracy in reviewing documentation and financial records.  
Analytical skills with the ability to detect patterns, discrepancies, and areas for improvement.  
Understanding and adhering to HIPAA and other government and healthcare industry regulations.  
Strong written and verbal communication skills to provide constructive feedback and report findings.  
Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and prioritize responsibilities effectively.  
Extensive knowledge of insurance guidelines including Medicare and other government payers, private, self\-insurance, and managed\-care plans.  
Familiarity with auditing techniques and principles within a healthcare revenue cycle setting.  
Knowledge of MS Office including Outlook, Word and Excel  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills  
Excellent attention to detail and time management skills  
Excellent customer service skills.  


Education \& Experience Requirements  


High School Diploma  
Minimum 3\-4 years revenue cycle experience  


Job Type: Full\-time  


Benefits:

* 401(k) matching

A company that believes you are part of the solution and values your input when solving complex problems? A place where you are recognized and rewarded for your work? We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry\-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting\-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. The Call Center Specialist \- IC is responsible for managing a high volume of inbound and outbound calls in a timely and professional manner. This role involves providing exceptional customer service, scheduling appointments, answering inquiries, and assisting patients and their families with accurate information regarding services provided by the healthcare organization. The ideal candidate will have excellent communication skills, empathy, and the ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
  

  

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Handle incoming and outgoing calls efficiently while maintaining a professional and courteous demeanor.
* Schedule patient appointments accurately using the organization's electronic medical record (EMR) system.
* Respond to patient inquiries regarding services, appointment availability, billing, and other general information.
* Assist patients in rescheduling or canceling appointments while adhering to organizational guidelines.
* Verify and update patient demographic and insurance information during calls.
* Educate patients on healthcare services, office policies, and available resources.
* Document all patient interactions and maintain accurate call records in the appropriate systems.
* Document patient complaints and escalate complex issues to the appropriate department or supervisor.
* Collaborate with clinical staff, administrative teams, and other departments to ensure a seamless patient experience.

* Achieve performance goals, including call quality, response time, and customer satisfaction metrics.
